decisions.reason: Having survived its first review and fitting the firm's specialist demanding-environment capabilities, the naval vessel lighting line would likely be retained while management allows for the long sales and qualification cycles typical of this niche.

The spring-balanced desk lamp remains more peripheral than the firm's core systems business, but as a large firm with some slack and an ergonomic workplace offering, management would more likely keep it than drop it unless results clearly fall short of aspiration.

This general interior luminaire is close to the firm's core building-lighting business and its continued presence after launch suggests performance is at least acceptable relative to aspiration, making withdrawal unlikely.

Because the marine searchlight survived while the marine HMI searchlight was already withdrawn, management would infer that F is the more viable maritime option and keep it unless demand disappoints materially.
